static_traits.name: 李正辉
static_traits.family_status: 有一位支持性的伴侣；因通勤压力Strained relationships with family members
static_traits.social_status: 有伴侣支持，但not愿与朋友讨论该困扰，担心他们without法理解
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前not yet接受心理咨询；过去not yet出现与通勤相关的类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，合作度高，逻辑性较强；能自我Reflection；语气紧张，存在灾难化与预测not yet来的倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 因每日通勤（每程约一小时，交通状况糟糕）导致的压力和Anxiety显著增加，且担心交通只会越来越糟。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望通过咨询降低每日通勤引发的压力与Anxiety，找到更好的应对方式，并改善工作表现、睡眠与Family relationships。

core_beliefs: 我without法掌控外部环境，因而难以有效应对

special_situations.event: Driving to commute during morning and evening rush hours daily, severe traffic congestion
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦交通拥堵，整天都会被毁，压力not可避免
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在车上听舒缓音乐和播客以缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today's traffic will be awful, and it will only get worse and worse.

special_situations.event: Thinking about tomorrow's commute before bed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not提前担心并做好心理准备，明天会更糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays up late worrying, repeatedly imagines the worst case, leading to difficulty falling asleep
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Tomorrow's traffic will definitely be worse.

special_situations.event: Arrives at the company already tired from the congested commute
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being drained by traffic before work means my work performance today will be poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to push through and complete work tasks

special_situations.event: Interacting with family after returning home from work (still in a high-stress and irritable state after commuting)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 通勤让我心情糟糕，因此我without法与家人好好相处
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Less communication or responding in an irritable tone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我回家时心情一定很差，肯定会和家人闹not愉快。

core_conflict.wish: Longs for a stable, controllable daily life and calm emotions, able to work smoothly and live harmoniously with family
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失去控制导致工作受损、Relationship tension与身心耗竭
defense_goal: 通过提前担忧和预设最坏情境来获得控制感并降低not确定性

object_relations.self_representation: 被外界环境压垮的without助者
object_relations.object_representation: not可控、压迫性的外部环境（拥堵交通）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探讨其对not yet来交通的负面预测并邀请其检验证据时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向将“提前担心”视为必要与负责任，担心若not担心就会失控
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以理性、坚持的语气为自己的担忧寻找合理理由，列举路况变差的实例，回避对Anxiety情绪的直接感受与探讨。

manifestations: not愿与朋友讨论通勤压力，担心他们without法理解
伴侣虽支持但without法完全理解压力的程度

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: not向朋友求助与分享该困扰
Digests stress alone during the commute, trying to self-regulate by listening to music and podcasts
Repeatedly worrying alone before bed about the next day's commute

exception_events.target_problem: 在早晚通勤时，来访者通常会提前灾难化预测并产生强烈Anxiety，抵达公司时已感到疲惫，回家后易怒导致Strained relationships with family members。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 偶尔有一天交通have not他Anticipation得那么糟，实际行车较为顺畅；相较平时，他的紧张与烦躁减轻，通勤体验not那么糟糕。
exception_events.reason: 线索：当日拥堵程度较低（情境not同）；由于播客内容更能吸引注意力（做法有效），因此Anxietynot yet持续攀升。

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to try cognitive restructuring and practice gratitude
Able to find positives in work and podcasts and do some self-regulation
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、过度概括等认知偏差显著
睡前反复担忧导致Sleep impaired与疲惫
not愿与朋友讨论问题导致Insufficient use of social support
对外部环境的not可控性感到without力与失控

target_behavior.behavior: 通勤相关的高度Anxiety与灾难化预测
antecedent: Driving commutes at morning and evening rush hours; severe road congestion
target_behavior.core_reason: 对not可控交通环境的灾难化认知和对not yet来的负面预测，使其以担忧与过度警觉来寻求控制感
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与without力感、获得主观的控制感与准备感
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance，回家后易怒导致Tense family relationships，睡眠被扰动
